repeatAssessments.assessment: Stable: all three runs used one search, two steps, and a direct Tokyo answer with a Britannica citation.
Minor variance: one repeat used three searches while the other two used one; all runs distinguished major first-release and last-update dates and stated the LTS caveat.
Stable quality with repeated structural overhead: all three runs used four searches, and all three contained duplicate npm/pnpm result URLs across queries.
Stable: all three runs covered test runner, fetch, and permission model with official Node.js citations; search count varied from three to four.
Stable: all three runs rejected CRA for new production apps, reconciled old tutorials, and cited current React guidance.
Material variance: baseline was complete, but two of three runs reached all six steps; one ended with an incomplete answer and a webfetch error after 51K-character specification output.
